GSAP licence note

Library:      GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform)
Version:      3.15.1
Files here:   gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js (unmodified, their own notices kept)
Downloaded:   2026-11-06 from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.1/dist/
              Each file matched the sha256 in jsDelivr's package listing.

Licence:      GSAP Standard "No Charge" License
Link:         https://gsap.com/standard-license
Date checked: 2026-11-05
Page dates:   Effective April 30, 2025. Last modified May 30, 2025.

The npm package ships no licence file, so this note stands in for one and the
terms themselves live at the link above. In short, as read on the date checked:

- Free to use, including commercial use and all plugins.
- Not allowed: using GSAP in no-code visual animation builders that compete with
  Webflow, and removing or changing GSAP's notices.
- Webflow can update or end the licence, so read the current page again before
  this site is ever made public.
- Self-hosting is not named directly. It was treated as covered by the licence's
  general permission to use and reproduce GSAP in a website.

This summary is not legal advice and does not replace the licence at the link.
